name: Female_Adult_01 (Microsoft Rocketbox Avatar Library)
creator: Microsoft (Rocketbox Studios)
modifications: converted FBX to GLB with scripts/people/rocketbox-to-glb.mjs (config scripts/people/female-adult-01.json)
Phong materials rebuilt as PBR: specular map remapped to roughness, metalness 0, alpha-cutout hair/lash atlas
2048 TGA textures downscaled to 1024 and re-encoded (JPEG opaque, PNG cutout)
centimetres scaled to metres; vertex colors and FBX authoring light removed
base (non-facial) mesh only; 175 facial blendshapes not included

clips retargeted by bone name (rotations plus root translation): idle (idle_breathe_01), talk (gestic_talk_neutral_01, first 12 s), walk (walk_neutral_01, made in-place by removing linear root travel), wave (wave_01), look-around (idle_look_around_01), think (idle_scratch_head_01), crouch (crouch_idle)
attribution: Microsoft Rocketbox Avatar Library, Copyright (c) 2020 Microsoft, MIT License.
